1-usflag-blink.feedback:
I know this one appears to be "good" but trust me it looks weird.  But that's because the src material is pretty bad too.  For example, what they chose to animate here (the stars) looks really weird and makes it look LESS like a US flag.  if anything should be animated it should be either the strips or to move things back and forth a little bit.

So I'd like you to make your own.  Don't worry about the src material.  You know what US flag looks like.  I'd like you to also split this into two patterns.  1D and 2D.  Keept in mind that what animates well will be different between them.
